D: A scientist's teleportation experiment goes wrong and fuses him with a fly.
P: Serve the steak when Seth teleports one and it tastes wrong.
S: Seared garlic butter sirloin cubes with a horseradish sour cream dip
Sirloin in cubes seared hard in a smoking pan, butter, garlic and thyme basted in, rested, served on toothpicks with horseradish cream.
Bartok party blinis and goat's cheese figs
the Bartok press party where Seth meets Veronica

Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, alongside fresh figs stuffed with goat's cheese and drizzled with honey and thyme. Warm 16 store-bought blinis at 180C for 5 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche from 150g, a fold of smoked salmon from 150g, a dill sprig and lemon zest. Cut a cross in the tops of 6 figs and press in 120g soft goat's cheese. Drizzle with 1 tbsp honey, scatter thyme leaves and grill 2 minutes until warm. Serve both on a tray.
M: Veronica says the teleported steak tastes synthetic

Dry-aged style rib eye seared in cast iron and pulled medium rare, with a proper béarnaise, crispy potatoes and dressed watercress, the real thing. Salt 2 large rib eye steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast 1kg diced potatoes in oil at 220C for 40 minutes. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 1 tbsp tarragon vinegar over simmering water until thick, then slowly whisk in 150g melted butter, add chopped tarragon and salt. Sear the steaks in smoking cast iron, flipping every minute, to 52C, rest 8 minutes and slice. Serve with watercress dressed in oil and lemon.
Roast pork belly glazed with soy, honey and ginger, rice and greens
Pork belly roasted at 150C for 2 hours, then glazed with soy, honey, brown sugar and ginger under a hot grill until sticky. Steamed rice and greens.
W: Pears baked in brown sugar, butter and vanilla, served with cream
Pears baked in butter, brown sugar and vanilla until soft and sticky, with cream. Halve 4 pears and core.
Fried yeast doughnut rounds tossed in caster sugar
Yeasted dough rested an hour, cut into rounds, proved, fried at 175C for 90 seconds a side, tossed in caster sugar while warm.
K: Double espresso, brown sugar syrup and cold milk, topped with cream

Espresso shaken with a dark brown sugar syrup and ice, poured over cold milk with a cap of sweet cream, for when the sugar cravings kick in. Simmer 100g dark brown sugar with 100ml water for 2 minutes to make a syrup and cool. Brew 4 double espressos (or 250ml very strong coffee). Shake each shot with 25ml syrup and a handful of ice. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, pour over the coffee and top with 2 tbsp lightly whipped cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Cube the steak up to 4 hours ahead and keep it in the fridge, and mix the horseradish cream up to 2 days ahead; season and sear to order

steps.text: Cut the steak into cubes and season well.
Sear in a smoking pan in batches.
Baste with the butter, garlic and thyme.
Rest.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and serve with the steak on toothpicks.

veg.make_ahead: Cut and score the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge, and mix the horseradish cream up to 2 days ahead; season and sear to order

steps.text: Cut the mushrooms into thick coins, score the cut faces and season with the salt.
Sear in the oil in a smoking pan in batches until well browned.
Baste with the butter, garlic and thyme.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and serve with the mushrooms on toothpicks.

dishes.make_ahead: Best fried just before serving; mix the dough and rest it in the fridge up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, butter, egg, a little of the sugar and the warm water into a dough and rest.
Roll out and cut rounds.
Prove.
Heat the oil to 175C.
Fry a few at a time, 90 seconds a side.
Toss in caster sugar while warm.

dishes.make_ahead: Roast the pork belly and make the glaze up to 2 days ahead and keep both in the fridge; slice, brush and grill on the night

steps.text: Roast the pork belly at 150C.
Simmer the soy, honey, sugar and ginger until syrupy.
Slice the pork and brush with glaze.
Grill until sticky.
Steam the rice and cook the bok choy.

veg.make_ahead: Roast the eggplant and make the glaze up to 1 day ahead and keep both in the fridge; brush and grill on the night

steps.text: Toss the eggplant in the oil and roast at 220C until soft and golden.
Simmer the soy, honey, sugar and ginger until syrupy.
Brush the eggplant with the glaze.
Grill until sticky.
Steam the rice and cook the bok choy.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; rewarm in a low oven and serve with cold cream

steps.text: Halve and core the pears.
Lay cut side up in a dish with the butter, sugar, vanilla and water.
Bake at 180C, basting.
Serve with cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and cool the syrup up to 1 week ahead, and brew and chill the coffee up to 2 days ahead, both in the fridge; shake and pour to serve

steps.text: Simmer the sugar with the water for 2 minutes to make a syrup and cool.
Brew very strong coffee.
Shake each coffee with syrup and ice.
Fill tall glasses with ice and milk and pour over the coffee.
Top with lightly whipped cream.

s.note: Seared garlic butter sirloin cubes with a horseradish sour cream dip
s.how: Cut 600g sirloin into cubes and season well. Sear in a smoking pan in batches, then baste with 40g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme. Rest 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tbsp horseradish. Serve on toothpicks.

m.note: Roast pork belly glazed with soy, honey and ginger, rice and greens
m.how: Roast 1kg pork belly at 150C for 2 hours. Simmer 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger until syrupy. Slice the pork, brush with glaze and grill until sticky. Serve with 300g steamed rice and greens.

w.note: Pears baked in brown sugar, butter and vanilla, served with cream
w.how: Halve 4 pears and core. Lay cut side up in a dish with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar, a split vanilla bean and 100ml water. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes, basting, and serve with cream.

w.note: Fried yeast doughnut rounds tossed in caster sugar
w.how: Mix 350g flour, 7g yeast, 40g butter, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar and 180ml warm water and rest an hour. Roll out, cut rounds and prove 30 minutes. Fry at 175C for 90 seconds a side and toss in 100g caster sugar while warm.

d.note: Double espresso, brown sugar syrup and cold milk, topped with cream
d.how: Simmer 100g dark brown sugar with 100ml water for 2 minutes to make a syrup and cool. Brew 4 double espressos (or 250ml very strong coffee). Shake each shot with 25ml syrup and a handful of ice. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, pour over the coffee and top with 2 tbsp lightly whipped cream.
